title: Mike Macdonald: Sam Darnold's hip looks good, but we don't know how long he'll miss

sources.title: Mike Macdonald: Sam Darnold's hip looks good, but we don't know how long he'll miss
sources.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will miss some time with the hip injury that knocked him out of Wednesday night's game.
